items.title: Better A2 a2param-beta-2026.11.19.1
items.body: Better A2 a2param-beta-2026.11.19.1 is available. Open the release page for details and downloads.

items.title: Better A2 v0.0.4-beta.2
items.body:
- Fix startup ordering: select a readable process without old offsets, resolve the profile before telemetry probes, and load the applied core globals in the telemetry reader.
- Return a controlled JSON error for missing PID and fix table placeholders.
- Give F9 counterattack time to confirm the selected attacker and retry after two seconds when the Tab sweep ends.
- Keep live F9 resources eligible when the approximate obstacle grid cannot find a path; use direct approach and the existing no-progress recovery.

items.title: Better ESP v3.1
items.body:
3.1 — Global Steam — 2026-11-18

- Extract the complete archive. Run build\aion_external_v3.1.exe with the same
- elevation as the game. Keep aion_offsets.a2params, assets and languages beside it.
- English is the default; choose another language in CONFIG.
- The optional input backend requires its driver; the existing installer is included.

items.title: Better A2 v0.0.4-beta.1
items.body:
- Keep the launcher and updater as the two files in the package root.
- Share images across both map views.
- Give F9 counterattack time to confirm the selected attacker and retry after two seconds when the Tab sweep ends.
- Keep live F9 resources eligible when the approximate obstacle grid cannot find a path; use direct approach and the existing no-progress recovery.

items.title: Better A2 v0.0.3-beta.8
items.body:
- Add CUR with 1,316 known points and 12 linked points
- Add Drop Materials to the map and drop data
- Update selected materials. An empty selection admits all verified points inside the active area
- Enable CUR for route and F9
- Improve ground obstacle navigation
- Improve navigation recovery checks using actual character movement
- Add navigation-grid diagnostics to the existing gather input log
- Fix F9 Od model matching
- Airborne behavior is unchanged
